text: This, along with Domini dreams, etc, are probably the worst and fun limiting games out there. You start off really enjoying it and investing in the game, the fun graphics, etc, and then before you know it, you have no coins to play. The amount that are used for each round is so overpriced it's ridiculous! Bottomed out at level 55. And the games algorithm is actually very flawed. Luck-chance with turns are bizarre to say the least. It's almost as if it's designed to set you up to fail.

very RNG. doesn't work off lives like most other games, it works off spending coins to attempt a level. the further you progress the more coins you have to spend on a level. It is not uncommon to be down to 1 or 2 cards left to clear but having to flip 6, 7, 8 cards without getting one you can use. Experienced more often than not and failing the level. The game seems to be designed to make you spend money, not enjoyable when you can only earn limited coins every hour, barely enough 4 an attempt.

game is good and simple, easy to play, that's the upside. but downside pop-ups in the game, wanting you to buy up grades in the meantime, the more levels you compleat, the in-game coins, you lose fast. and I don't like the pig bank collecting the coins, then having to pay £2.69 real cash to get them this game is a money grabber, and this makes me very vexed.

I've played the game for years and enjoyed it. Since the update I don't receive any notification to receive my hourly harvest. I've lost 1000's of tokens, because of this. Reported it through the app. Was told to restart my device, which I did. It's no better. Support said that they're aware of the problem and are "working on it". It's needs to be sorted out asap.

Been playing this game for a long time (just past level 27000) and I've noticed changes which are obviously meant to increase sales - like when the option to get an extra pick via watching an add was removed, and over the past days I've noticed the credit picks have massively decreased (used to be able to get 80K or 90K in each, and now it's 15K or 20K). It barely makes it worthy now getting the 60 stars or over, for the rewards you get. Other than that, I find the game quite entertaining.

The game has become almost impossible on mobile. I won over 1mil coins, but lost them all pretty much straight away because I cant seem to win any levels any more. I've been playing this game for years and with every update it gets less and less enjoyable. You can only get most perks on new levels now, which means if you wanna replay old levels to get 3 stars, you get penalised. I'm very close to getting rid of it cause its just not fun anymore and only seems to be about getting my money.

Used to be a great game, and still is to a certain extent. The daily bonuses are getting worse and worse, the amount of money needed to get anywhere is ridiculous now, for instance piggy bank now over £16 to open. Some of the missions are crazy hard to do, i have 1 right now where I have to win 12 levels on the most expensive coin one, if I don't buy coins, it can't be completed. You are spoiling what was a brilliant game by pricing out everyone. I am seriously considering deleting altogether.

Reviewing to get extra coins. It's an ok game, but as others have said (long term players not newbies like me), it's very expensive to keep playing. Eg Cost 4k a game, IF you win, you might get 4.4k, if you lose it might be 300 coins. Ergo chances are you'll very quickly be unable to afford to play for free. (Yes you get an hourly harvest which barely covers 1 game).

Starts off nice enough, decent graphics and all, though looking overcrowded with so many sub-plots and additional scenes that require attention. Before long it becomes almost impossible to get ahead without buying items in-game. I don't begrudge the makers funding at all but it is a bit too obvious here that they hook you with nice gameplay and then (way too quickly) go for your wallet.

Lost 500 of the crowns when trying to purchase packs. I contacted the support team but just got ignored - this is an addictive game so you end up spending quite a lot of hours on it, just hope that in that time you don't have anything go wrong because I don't think there is anyone on the other side listening. Have to love the suggestion by the developer to resubmit my ticket. Fool me once...

Frustrating. As others say, the game is designed to harvest your hard earned cash. You quickly run out of coins which are required to play a level. The level system also scales poorly, before long you will only be able to play one or two levels a day because they game economy is rubbish. It is not always possible to complete a level and full days savings of coins can be gone in 30 seconds trying to get the last card. I do not recommend

been playing this for years. It used to be the best game as you could complete the mini game and win races and others, but now it just looks unless you spend money on the app you get nowhere. I went from being a top player completing the farms to now not completing nothing. this game has lost its fun factor in keeping my interest. thinking of uninstalling it if I do not see an improvement for us that don't want to spend money on a game

Basically the same as all the other reviews. I just want to play solitaire but this game makes it completely unrelaxing because of how few coins you gain vs spend to win a game. 80% of games you will have to buy the extra deck of cards to complete it no matter how 'well' you played because of the luck of the cards. It's obviously to try and encourage you to spend real money. It's ad free, but honestly I would much rather have some ads and actually be able to play more often than every few hours.

I love it! Alwais come back to play although it's quite hard to get coins, you need to buy eventually. Beside that, graphics are nice, gameplay very good and I love it! Even though I love the game, after playing for 2 years and buying lots of times coins which are not cheap at all, I must say "wanna play?... PAY" . It makes me really sad that, after all the money spent on this game, there are moments when you spend several days to win a game if you do not pay!

I love solitaire and this game is really fun to play, the graphics are cute and colourful buut as others have said, it's the credits that let the game down. It eats your credits and if I didn't already have a solitaire game then I would have been so disappointed to have to wait for another harvest to gain a few more credits to keep going. You have the bar set too high where credits are concerned. If you fix it then you will get five stars :P

whilst I enjoy this game and have played it since 2022. it's becoming more and more frustrating if you refuse to buy more coins , or the packages with real money . it holds you on a level. I've been stuck on the same level for a day and a half now purely because I won't spend real money. very tempted to delete the game and try something different

I think this is the greediest game I have ever played and in today's market, that is saying something. Game deliberately makes it so you run out of coins fast, to the extent that you pay up or you can play ONE game of cards per hour. Absolute waste of time. Plenty of other good solitaire games out there. Avoid this app like the plague, the developers need a reality check on this one.

Starts off a normal solitaire game then levels literally get impossible without spending coins. Avoid like the plague. Just to ensure there's no misunderstanding, the levels get to a point where it is literally impossible to progress with the standard set of cards that you are given. You must use additional coins and/or bonuses etc. to progress. Nothing to do with how "challenging" the game is as the developers are trying to make out.

I understand pop ups as its ad free, so you take one or the other, but gameplay and winning levels is so difficult, even when the game gives you what seems to be a generous amount of game "cash", you'll lose it so quickly. other gifts are worthless, not worth it, loads of games out there with better game play and quicker in game functions. downgrading to a 1, last three days I've completed three legs on average due to difficulty and lack of game cash, uninstalling, don't bother.

The luck in this game is suspiciously bad because they want you to waste real money to buy more of their stupidly overpriced credits. It's almost impossible to beat a level on the first try if you don't buy more cards, which cost over twice as much as you get in return for completing the level and sometimes are completely useless. It also has annoyingly long animations where you can't do anything in game because you need to wait for multiple ads which try to get you to buy more credits to load.

Good time pass But since the latest few updates. It's like taking forever collecting bonuses etc. 10 presses of the button or more. It's getting ridiculous now. Feel like just deleting and moving on to a different one. But I have been playing this game a long time and don't want to let go just yet. Everything else about the game is Bang on. But collecting bonuses is a nightmare. Get it fixed guys. Hence why 4 stars. Would have been 5. But a great game overall.

I love this game. BUT, it's so expensive to play. You win so many levels, and the price of a level goes up. If you don't spend mega bucks you can only play once an hour after collecting "free" coins. But to win the extra coins, or at least have a chance you need to play using more coins (each level has a up to win x4 more) it's ridiculous. Sadly, I just cannot afford to play anymore...

Pros: Fun game, has enough to keep you interested and quite addictive. Cons: obviously you need to pay if you just want to play constantly. But also the 'luck' noticibly changes. This can be seen near the end of levels. On early levels, the number of cards required to match a single card is rarely more than 3 or 4 cards - and you'll often hit success on the last card. In later levels it is common to go through 10 or more cards without success - as though the game has already decided you'll lose

It's a nice little game. Spins can be a bit frustrating as it never seems to land on the decent token prizes. Too many extra things going on which to progress you need to complete the levels at a higher token rate. These aren't easy to always pass. Spend money to get tokens and you'll be fine. I don't buy tokens so I just potter along and ignore a lot of the competitions.

Game is great but the number of pop ups trying to get you to buy is ridiculous. You literally get them on every game. It is really annoying and will end up in me uninstalling the game. Update, the game updated and I've been trying to play a level for minutes now. The pop ups forcing you to buy don't stop so now I can only view pop ups and not even play. Am uninstalling. Money grabbers should spend more time fixing the game and issues rather than harassing us to spend constantly.

I really enjoyed playing this.....at first. Sadly, after playing the earlier levels it became apparent that real money would need to be paid quite often to continue playing. It's possible to play a few levels a day with the coins awarded for winning and the hourly harvest. However, the levels become more and more expensive to play as do getting extra cards and/or the wild cards necessary to beat the levels. Fine to play if you're happy to play for a very short time each day or pay a fair bit.

FEB 2021. Still could be a good game but oh, now, the juddering and refusing to play - every update seems to bring a fresh problem. I have made contact with them several times but afraid it isn't getting any better. I even uninstalled it, and I had several milion points at that time to lose, left it for a couple of weeks but no improvement when reinstalled. The good thing was that it installed where it left off. I am sticking with it but not for much longer. What a shame they can't fix it.

I don't like to do this but my 5 star rating has gone down to 2. Please guys sort it out, just look at the reviews your getting, I don't want to stop playing the game I love it but since the updates in July myself and multiple people have had problems, please don't reply with 'submit a ticket' as I've done that and nothing has changed! I can't access the my farm segment which has 7 days left, if its not sorted I'll lose 1m coins, I really hope you'll extend the 7 days. Please sort it.

Now in the 40s levels. A lot of fun, I really like this game although I find the rules rather confusing at times and even though I know it's a game and none of it really matters, I still find some of the money expended (not the real money purchases) quite alarming. I must remember that it is only a game! 😄. Getting more confused at Sam's birthday bash which looks fun but I don't understand what I'm being asked to do. I don't seem to understand the words being used, are they American? I'm just

I love this game and I've been playing it for well over a year if not more. I've spent more money on it than I care to imagine which is my own fault I know! But... I'm on level 3941 the cost per level is now 10,000 to buy a wild in game is 30,000! I only get 20,000 a day bonus money, you can only harvest every hour for basically one level paid for. The reason I'm giving it 3 stars is because It should automatically harvest for you and each level and add ons should be cheaper to name but a few!

Think the game needs to have another update! Because since the last one it's become impossible to play. It doesn't matter how well you play the levels because you don't seem to get the cards you need. Also its costing alot more to play levels and there's no other way to get coins other than spending real money! Or waiting 1hour for your crop to harvest, which for players like me who hasn't been playing long only gives you 2,500 so enough to play 1 level!.

It was a really good game, played for a very long time. But since the big update, it doesn't load and caution (!) Still flashes to update, when you go to update there is nothing to update. I may have to move on to another game. Quite dissappointed!!!! I did as asked, contacted the support team, no answer still!!! 27th Aug- your support team have still not contacted me about this game and its issues, very bad service. I'm uninstalling this game as you are clearly not able to resolve the issues.

Love this game, very addictive but sadly is getting to the point of not being able to pass levels unless you spend money. Have requested refunds after spending my own money and been told no as the game is meant to be hard and challenging. I understand that but sometimes it takes me 3 days and alot of credits to pass 1 level. Please be careful if downloading. It's a money grabber this one. Very disappointed as never known a game like it! Sorry but had 5 stars and now down to 1 star

Started off good but the more you get into it the more it forces you to buy credits.. supposed to be random cards during play? How's about getting the same card during a game, that doesn't match, 3x in a row.. also wild/x5 cards prices are a sheer joke. Avoid and now uninstalled. Same applies to their Golden Prairies which basically is the exact same game.

Love the game but sometimes when trying to get in to play it, you get into the game but won't let you click onto anything, even tried coming back out it and back in again but still nothing, have kept it updated every time there is a update to be done. Considering the amount of money I have put in to the game I'm not very happy about it tbh.

There's clearly a lot of thought been put into the graphics and the "quests" to keep things fun and interesting, which is nice - especially as it's so rare these days. I also like that I can play offline too - and that I'm not swamped by ads if I leave the phone online. Having said that, it's not fun or enjoyable to play. It only becomes so when you use real money to buy power-ups. But you don't win real cash. Much like the real world, it's a hard slog if you don't have money to throw at it.

Absolutely addicted to this game. Not sure what people are on about though... On level 39 and have been made to make an in app purchase to be able to continue. I'm on level 4153 and never had to spend any money on this app! If you run out of coins, simply wait for the hour to be up to get more (for free) and at midnight each night you get a bonus amount with some free rounds from time to time

Game is enjoyable but massively expensive now. All purchase have shot up. I understand there are costs & overheads but there's no way I can justify spending over £40 a month for the Golden Ticket, almost £8 for Peggy etc. I play other games where 'special' passes are less than £5 & last the whole month or until you complete an entire section. Prices in this game are now unaffordable so loyal players miss out on bonuses & special prizes. Think I'll be deleting the game. Disappointed.

What is the point in a game that makes you pay in game money to play, but doesn't pay out enough to continue after a certain point? Some levels conveniently drain your money. The last 15 levels I've done I've gone from over 100K to nothing and now can't play. Yes I'm at level 186 but the levels aren't overly hard, you just get all the way down to the last couple cards on the table and conveniently, no matter how many you have in your deck, the game will just give you rubbish and duplicates.

Usually I love this game, it's the longest game I've ever kept on playing and i enjoy it daily. The latest update however has done something that now means my farm won't load so I can't claim my bonus coins every 24 hours.... and the cards I've spent the last few weeks collected also won't load meaning that with about 14 days left to play for collecting them, it now isn't letting me do this?! Very annoying, hope the update sorts itself out ASAP!

Was 5* until 2 days ago. I've loved this game, it's the only game I've kept and not deleted, defo helps my autistic tendancies! I'm so close to reaching level 1000. However I've not been able to open the app for 2 days. Reading another review it's because of a phone update? Perhaps not the games fault but guys, sort it out, update, do whatever you need to, to keep up!

It's getting ridiculous!!! I'm at the level 1160 and level 19 of the farm ( 2 days left to finish) so obviously levels are extremely difficult to pass. I lost the count of how many times you should play 1 level to pass it...even using 5 boosters you won't pass or having 1 card left many times you won't pass the level. I guess they're just pushing us to spend money... that's rather disappointing because I love the game!

Riddled with problems. Far too many freezing and crashing issues usually on the mini dice game jungle throws. Not even mentioning the sound problems where it seems to pause and skip. Now I noticed that I don't get any free rounds any more. I've supposedly won free rounds, but never get them. Fed up as they're not cheap to play now at 56k. Used to be a great game until recently

I really enjoy the game, its very moorish. But you eat through your credit way too quickly. Playing the game costs only a little less than you can win, credits only renew every hour and that's only enough for one game and a wild card or extra cards can cost you double or triple what you can win from completing. So ive ended up spending money on credits that really don't last long. So unless you're amazing at this and win every time then don't get hooked as it'll cost you real £.

Sort out the glitches. This game was 5* until the recent big update. Now it struggles to load, often freezing when partly loaded so that I have to task manage out and try again (sometimes multiple times) or it completely crashes. It's done this in-game too, and the coins I've used to play are not refunded. Annoyed me enough that I've come here specifically to say something. And no, it's not my phone, I have the latest snazzy lump of tech, and it's fully upgraded. This issue is your end. Fix it!

The game itself is fun. But after a while, the levels become SO expensive and the income is SO low. It will cost 2,500 to try one regular level, and the hourly "harvest" gives you 2,200. So it takes you over an hour to get enough coins to try a level ONCE. If you win a level, the profit is so small that it feels unrewarding. The level will cost 2,000, and the reward will be 2,400. And the single "wildcard" bonuses cost 6000 in a level that costs 2000, making them useless. The greed is insane.

This is a great way to kill time and if im honest i spend way too much time playing it, but like others I feel it is costly to play either in tokens or actual cash. I collected a sizeable amount of tokens, daily and hourly bonus plus watch ads for double credit and use that to play a few rounds. I love the graphics too. Lately though the game seem to be stuck. It isn't advancing and takes me leaving the game for it to advance to the next level. It also takes a while to add the stars. Fix pl.

Loved this game and have been playing for years, it has it's faults like the constant ads when you just want to play, like the strawberry game and need more like this to feel competitive. Unfortunately, I will have to delete this app unless the developers can revise. i cannot log into the game now, it freezes when I go to collect my daily bonus, click on everything but just does not work. Shame, as i've had so many years playing. Will reward more stars if fixed.

I used to play this all the time, but the latest upgrade fixed a glitch which means that playing at the highest levels uses masses of coins and makes it impossible to progress. It seems that the reward for loyalty is to have your game time reduced hugely, unless you spend a fortune on in app purchases. I'm just gonna stop playing when my coins run out, which will be in about 5 minutes.

the game is a joke . sometimes it can take up tp 15 attempts just to pass 1 level wiping all your coins . the game is designed to force you to spend money if you actually want to play the game . you would get a lot more people paying for things if you could actually pass a level without having to play it 20 times awful game

Really enjoyed up to level 50 or so, then up to 100 took a week of hard work and going on every hour to harvest to get enough coins to play a round. If you don't get enough boosters, or win that round the money is wasted, it's random as all card games are, so no matter how much skill, you may not have enough coins to buy extra cards or options, then it takes hours of harvesting to try again.

Fun for first 20 levels - Then it becomes a grind. The cost for playing each level, increases exponentially. With 20k credits I was easily able to play the first 25 levels.... now that I'm on lvl 52, I can spend around 15k just on 1 level. Its completely unbalanced. This means that you have to wait several hours before you can play another match. Don't download it - its effectively a money scam, play-to-win SOLITAIRE game.

Used to be fun, but unless you spend money it's pretty pointless. I loved it till it became money grabbing if you want to have a few playing rounds. There are other apps similar where you at least get a bit of game time in, which I find I'm playing more. Sadly, this game will run it's course like others when you can only play a few decent rounds if you spend.

I used to really love this game & would have given 5 stars BUT I'm really starting to feel like it's fixed. I'm playing the current challenge to build the farm - I've got to the last level and all of a sudden I'm losing 98% of games I play! Using 1000's coins, having to wait an hour to get more coins - enough to play 1 game, which I lose & have to wait again. It feels like they are trying to push me into paying money for coins so I can complete the challenge. Not fair after I've got so far!

Each update makes the game harder. We want to earn credits from winning games. You've now made this impossible 90% of the time. You're not listening to reviewers. We won't spend the money to complete a level that pays out only a quarter of what it takes to enter and win the round, we'll just uninstall. 5 days left of the panda garden, in on the last section, but I'm not going to be able to complete it now you've made it so difficult. If we wanted real chance, we'd play IRL with 1 deck of cards

Very enjoyable at first but once you get going and levels get harder, you never have enough coins to play more than a couple of games at a time (unless you want to be checking your phone every hour to harvest your crops). Seems like there needs to be a greater yield when you win a round or less expensive to play a new round.

It was good, it isn't now. They have stopped the option to watch a video for extra coins and videos for discount on cost. The coin cost to play each game is too high and its virtually impossible to pass a level on the first try (I'm past level 700). A harvest every hour only gives you a single try. I used to play on my breaks at work, now I just never have any coins to play.

All I wanted was a simple game. This just overwhelmed me. Every 5 seconds it's trying to show me a new screen with more content (ways to play, things to collect, extras to accomplish), when all I want to do is play a game! I wish it let me choose if/when I want to do the extra stuff OR just introduce extras slower (not over the space of 5 levels). Also, my music app crashes every time I open this game. I haven't had that issue with any other game..

I found some matches dodgy. Plenty of what I call dead cards that have no use. Sometimes it seems too obvious that you made little to no mistakes and as you approach the last few cards,you were never given the card that you needed because it was never there in the first place. They will then offer you an ad to watch so that they could offer you extra cards or extra coins. It is so obvious. The tactics or agenda that these lot push. Many matches were designed to lose. I suppose they need to sell

Game is a nightmare to load at times and often will unintentionally turn the phone on and off if say for the app is the last thing on screen. Sometimes even loading does this. Gameplay is fine but luck based. you can go through a lot of cards and still lose a level. The more you go on the more it costs per lvl for instance at around level 100. Its 2000 coins. Harvest is also round 2000. If you lose esp as mentioned above it can be frustrating to wait 1hr. 30mins if lucky per level.

This game exists to make you spend money. The games are designed to be lost so that you'll run out of coins frequently. When you're down to the last few cards to clear & you go through half the deck without a playable card, & it happens level after level, that's a feature, not a bug. If the devs' answer to this (like other reviews) is "yeah well 2m downloads" that just confirms your intent & lack of interest in making the game playable. Sure, they download, but how many keep playing long term?

This is my favourite solitaire game. I've tried a few others but this one tops my list because it has plenty of ways to boost your credits / power ups and doesn't force you to watch ads (although you are rewarded if you do!) I'm very rarely stuck for credits, and if I am the "harvest" is never that far away. I just reached level 700 and the levels have enough variety to keep it interesting.

This game gets worse the further you get into it. Now the game freezes and or shuts down in the middle of a game. I have rebooted and uninstalled and reloaded it but it still happens The creators of this game I know will blame it on my phone, well it is not the fault of my phone as all my other apps I have never had a problem with. They want you to part with your money but they cannot seem to be able to fix their glitches.

The app has frozen on the daily goodies screen. There is nothing I can press to collect a daily prize, or go straight to the game. I am around level 2200+, with over a million coins, so I do not want to uninstall and re-install in case I lose my progress. It has been like this for a couple of days. I have tried a few simple things to get it going without success. Please help.

Has been a great game for years, now not worth it. It has become impossible to progress and meet the side challenges without spending money and that takes the fun out of it. Even if you do stupidly spend money, it barely progresses you at all. The increased 4th level for collecting has downgraded what you used to get for the third grade, making it even harder to actually get anywhere and the side challenges have just become ridiculous. The daily bonus is mostly just an extra go and doesn't help

I've been playing for just over a week now. It was a really good game but I don't know what happened. Bonuses like dice rolls can now only be got if you win the level, I'm over level 300 it takes time for me to win. Carrots are only added if you play a level on the highest difficulty now, and that costs four times more gold than a regular level. Plus what you get for winning isn't proportionate. It costs four times as much to play but you don't win four times as much. I might uninstall, no fun.

At first this looks like a really good fun game, but it doesn't take long before you are faced with the decision to "pay to play" the free top ups are slow and quite often you cannot get past certain levels unless you buy credits or power ups, the play can be frustrating when you need one card to go out and even with 5 to 10 cards in your hand, surprise surprise it doesn't give you anything close. very dissapointed and feel like I have been let down by the developers. Shame on you!

Love the game BUT the cost of each level, particularly if you use any of the tools in it, mean you spend most of the day harvesting your farm to raise credits and managing to play just one or possibly two levels. It really seems to be a game that requires real money if you actually want to progress anywhere. Hate the bomb levels as if you don't have enough credits to buy a wildcard you can lose quite early on

It's a good game initially, but as you progress, it becomes less so. If you don't pay money for in-app purchases, then it becomes unrewarding. The 1 hour credits you get barely cover the amount needed for each level, so unless you are lucky and win, then 1 minute an hour is pretty much all you get. Plus, in-app purchases are far too expensive. To be honest, it just isn't enjoyable anymore. I've moved on to more rewarding games.

This game can be fun, but is ruined by being painfully pay-to-win. Every level costs coins to play. Beating a level barely gives more coins than paid, even when you raise the stakes. Challenges offer coins, but you often have to spend more than you'd win. Constant obnoxious pop-ups after every level to try and get you to spend on micro-transactions. Added 1* because, again, it can be fun... as long as you don't get stuck because you're out of coins & the RNG just won't give you the right cards

If you don't spend you don't play, there is no skill involved as the cards make the win possible or not. The cost of a game is 3x the amount of harvest you receive hourly and this doesn't accumulate. You have to load up the game each time. I enjoyed the first half hour and then realised that past level 30 you can play about one game a day and mostly the cards don't clear. You can use 5 cards but they cost twice the amount of a game!! I don't know why anybody would bother paying for this...

Designed to force you to spend your credits. Some games you can go 10-12 cards dealt without a single move. Then comes the pop up hard sell to buy in game credits. You'll get around 25 good levels into the game before it starts hurting you. Don't bother. Edit: lol @ developers response. I know how to play the game. You guys apparently know how to stack the deck so unplayable cards get dealt repeatedly. Stand by my review: it's a scam

It seems to me very time a new upgrade appears my Samsung A10 struggles even more. 50% of the time now my phone freezes even trying to enter the app. I've done reboots, checked settings, cleared caches and the game experience just gets worse. It's a shame because I like the game but it doesn't like my phone. Plenty of support from the developers but the problems are getting worse, constant freezes, inability to collect bonuses, phone lock ups during games. I don't want to a new phone to play.

Good fun but too many side games happening at once with no clear explanation about what is going on. They all detract from the main game and pyramid bonus game. Having one other game running at a time would be clearer and therefore more fun. Also the option of playing at a higher level to win bigger rewards is misleading: you DO win more but have to use more coins to play each level so don't actually gain anything eg 600 pts to win 1000 vs 6000 to win 6000!

VERY greedy after the first few levels. Ages waiting between brief dips into the game (brief because you can play barely at all for the gold you earned), therefore ages spent NOT playing just to gain access to one more board. So we get to play barely at all - not the way to get us hooked and paying real money. The UI is good but nothing else can be said for this because of the unjustifiable greed.

Have been playing this game for yours and would definitely have given it 5 stars without hesitation. These past 2 months, the game refuses to load or on the rare occasion it does, then it freezes. Have used customer support quite a few times and the answer seems to be generic in that they simply say to reboot my device. I feel that the app developers are just not listening. Hence, my 1 star rating. Disappointed is an understatement.

Edit - Having first reviewed this well over a year or so ago, I find that I must now warn all potential newcomers not to bother and to confirm how I agree with all of the most recent reviews about what a nightmare this game has become. It is a complete scam and completely encourages "pay to play". The levels have become impossible - so much so that you may have to play a level (at full cost each time) 5 - 10 times at least to actually pass. The payback for winning a level does not give enough for you to build a pot for continuous play so you find that you can only play a couple of levels before you are waiting for credits to refill. Show me anybody that has time to get the "free" refill on the hour all day long!!! Ridiculous - there are far better free to play games out there that do not rely on you putting your hand in your pocket to be able to actually play for a reasonable length of time. The other major frustration is that this developer is way behind its players - constantly waiting for new levels to be released and when they are they only release 75 at a time. Been waiting since 17th March since the last release and still no site of new levels. All of this at the same time that you are supposed to be growing your farm to win bigger prizes - well you cant build a farm when there are no new levels to play past level 7991. They will of course insist that you can play "Master League" but these games are even more impossible than the normal levels in the game. Shame this game has had to be ruined out of greed as it used to be great. You would have thought that players who were willing to watch ads all day long if they could to get credits to be able to play should have been enough - clearly not!!! Very unhappy and would have given it no stars now if I could.
